{{Quote|Any problems—tell the folks at Cikartan's tapcaf in town. They'll know how to contact me.|[[Venku Skirata]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
'''Cikartan's tapcaf''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] located within the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], and owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Cikartan]]. The tapcaf was in operation during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], and it's patrons during that time were acquainted with the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Venku Skirata]]. During Skirata's dealings with reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], he informed the aging [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that he could be reached via contacts at Cikartan's.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cikartan's tapcaf was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] via a brief mention in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
